08f61c7ea741f8e7.displayText: The town has a wall on three sides and a river on the fourth. You came in by the water gate, which is the one they do not watch, because nobody has ever arrived by river meaning harm. Not yet. The gatekeeper asks what is in your bag. It is a fair question. You have carried it four hundred miles.
08f61c7ea741f8e7.speechText: The town has a wall on three sides and a river on the fourth. You came in by the water gate, which is the one they do not watch, because nobody has ever arrived by river meaning harm. Not yet. The gatekeeper asks what is in your bag. It is a fair question. You have carried it four hundred miles.

e6fcc6246132b39d.displayText: The river has been low all summer. When the child goes in it is not deep enough to drown her, and deep enough that no one can see the bottom. Three people are standing closer to the water than you are. Not one of them has moved. You notice that you have already started walking.
e6fcc6246132b39d.speechText: The river has been low all summer. When the child goes in it is not deep enough to drown her, and deep enough that no one can see the bottom. Three people are standing closer to the water than you are. Not one of them has moved. You notice that you have already started walking.

147460731399ad73.displayText: A town this size cannot hold two of anything, so everyone here is called for what they do. There is a Reed and a Kettle and a woman called Thursday for reasons nobody will explain. At the well they ask what you should be called. They are not making conversation. Whatever you say will be true for forty years.
147460731399ad73.speechText: A town this size cannot hold two of anything, so everyone here is called for what they do. There is a Reed and a Kettle and a woman called Thursday for reasons nobody will explain. At the well they ask what you should be called. They are not making conversation. Whatever you say will be true for forty years.

8180454d522e2643.displayText: There is someone else here who does what you do. They do it worse — you can see it in the finish, and so could anyone who looked. Nobody looks. They are warm and quick and people like standing near them, so the work goes to them, and it comes back needing doing again inside the year.
8180454d522e2643.speechText: There is someone else here who does what you do. They do it worse — you can see it in the finish, and so could anyone who looked. Nobody looks. They are warm and quick and people like standing near them, so the work goes to them, and it comes back needing doing again inside the year.

35cc08e451c468b1.displayText: The old man's stock is yours to count now, because he cannot climb the stairs and his eyes have gone. There is more here than his book says. Not a little more. Nobody living knows what is in this room but you, and he will be dead before the year turns, and you have been hungry.
35cc08e451c468b1.speechText: The old man's stock is yours to count now, because he cannot climb the stairs and his eyes have gone. There is more here than his book says. Not a little more. Nobody living knows what is in this room but you, and he will be dead before the year turns, and you have been hungry.

c560349b5f8b063a.displayText: The frost came early and took the late crop with it. There is food in the town, but it is in cellars and it is not evenly spread, and everyone has begun doing sums about their neighbours. Someone has set an empty pot in the square. It has stood there two days. Nothing has gone into it.
c560349b5f8b063a.speechText: The frost came early and took the late crop with it. There is food in the town, but it is in cellars and it is not evenly spread, and everyone has begun doing sums about their neighbours. Someone has set an empty pot in the square. It has stood there two days. Nothing has gone into it.

cfc953fc8f11da19.displayText: You have the run of the workshop now, every bench and press and cupboard, except the low door at the back. She was clear about it and she was not unkind, and she gave no reason. She has been gone eleven days. Something behind that door has begun to smell of damp.
cfc953fc8f11da19.speechText: You have the run of the workshop now, every bench and press and cupboard, except the low door at the back. She was clear about it and she was not unkind, and she gave no reason. She has been gone eleven days. Something behind that door has begun to smell of damp.

6f3af6f266990248.displayText: The child has been at the door four mornings running and has asked for nothing, which is its own kind of asking. It is not a clever child. It is the other thing, which is rarer and harder to teach: it will stand in the cold and watch the same joint cut nine times without getting bored.
6f3af6f266990248.speechText: The child has been at the door four mornings running and has asked for nothing, which is its own kind of asking. It is not a clever child. It is the other thing, which is rarer and harder to teach: it will stand in the cold and watch the same joint cut nine times without getting bored.

8449a3260d8f10e0.displayText: It starts in the thatch two doors down and it is in your roof before anyone has finished shouting. You have the time it takes to cross the room once. The smoke is at head height and dropping. Everything you own is in here, and everything you own is not the same as everything that matters.
8449a3260d8f10e0.speechText: It starts in the thatch two doors down and it is in your roof before anyone has finished shouting. You have the time it takes to cross the room once. The smoke is at head height and dropping. Everything you own is in here, and everything you own is not the same as everything that matters.

a44d6b8870cfb296.displayText: A year, and they have asked you to stay, and there is a bench with your name on it. They have also asked you to sit on the body that decides who else may come in. There are more at the gate this year than last. You remember the water gate. You remember that nobody was watching it.
a44d6b8870cfb296.speechText: A year, and they have asked you to stay, and there is a bench with your name on it. They have also asked you to sit on the body that decides who else may come in. There are more at the gate this year than last. You remember the water gate. You remember that nobody was watching it.

9782393e385ef84f.displayText: You go at the thing nobody else will touch, and you cannot leave it while it is still wrong. Their searchers smashed bad work on the Saturday and paid a widow’s rent out of the Gill Stoup on the Sunday, and saw no contradiction in it. Neither do you. Mind the pressure, though: not everything yields to it, and some people are not problems to be solved.
9782393e385ef84f.speechText: You go at the thing nobody else will touch, and you cannot leave it while it is still wrong. Their searchers smashed bad work on the Saturday and paid a widow’s rent out of the Gill Stoup on the Sunday, and saw no contradiction in it. Neither do you. Mind the pressure, though: not everything yields to it, and some people are not problems to be solved.

36b73a4b62cca292.displayText: You join things. Timber, plans, folk who had stopped speaking to each other. Their word for a man who never made his essay was pendicle, and they meant it as the worst thing you could call somebody, because proof was not paperwork to them but the whole of a man’s standing. You will finish what you started or it will nag at you for years.
36b73a4b62cca292.speechText: You join things. Timber, plans, folk who had stopped speaking to each other. Their word for a man who never made his essay was pendicle, and they meant it as the worst thing you could call somebody, because proof was not paperwork to them but the whole of a man’s standing. You will finish what you started or it will nag at you for years.

4f5855960c885fbf.displayText: You build for people you will never meet. When the town said his arch would fall, Mungo Naismith slept the night under it, because argument is cheap and a night is not. That is your instinct exactly. The risk is mistaking permanence for rightness, and refusing to shift a thing that ought to shift.
4f5855960c885fbf.speechText: You build for people you will never meet. When the town said his arch would fall, Mungo Naismith slept the night under it, because argument is cheap and a night is not. That is your instinct exactly. The risk is mistaking permanence for rightness, and refusing to shift a thing that ought to shift.

1fce5c89913dec39.displayText: You are the one trusted with what must not leak. A barrel is thirty separate staves that hold only because they are bound, and the whole trade came down to one merciless question every Saturday morning: does it hold? You ask it of yourself first. Slacken the hoop now and then. Not everything precious wants gripping.
1fce5c89913dec39.speechText: You are the one trusted with what must not leak. A barrel is thirty separate staves that hold only because they are bound, and the whole trade came down to one merciless question every Saturday morning: does it hold? You ask it of yourself first. Slacken the hoop now and then. Not everything precious wants gripping.

ba9c9d2908f7a6d9.displayText: You see the crooked seam before anybody says a word. They kept a locked room where a man proved himself alone, and in 1724 they unseated their own Deacon over eleven unpaid pennies, because a rule that bends for the powerful is decoration. Fit is your religion. Some things have to breathe before they are finished.
ba9c9d2908f7a6d9.speechText: You see the crooked seam before anybody says a word. They kept a locked room where a man proved himself alone, and in 1724 they unseated their own Deacon over eleven unpaid pennies, because a rule that bends for the powerful is decoration. Fit is your religion. Some things have to breathe before they are finished.

eae7ae68dbff524a.displayText: You notice how the threads run. Their deacons served one year only, written down as being for the avoiding of all superioritie and tyrannie, and in 1615 they ruled that a master who withheld his knowledge from an apprentice had committed theft. That is your politics, whether or not you have ever said it aloud. You will carry loose ends that were never yours to carry.
eae7ae68dbff524a.speechText: You notice how the threads run. Their deacons served one year only, written down as being for the avoiding of all superioritie and tyrannie, and in 1615 they ruled that a master who withheld his knowledge from an apprentice had committed theft. That is your politics, whether or not you have ever said it aloud. You will carry loose ends that were never yours to carry.

8c59222c88cf6c34.displayText: You make the thing by which people are known. They knitted the blue bonnet out of waste wool until it was the badge of a whole country, then took in the dyers for one reason: a colour that fades is a small public lie. You would rather be true than fashionable. You would also rather change than die, and this craft has done exactly that twice.
8c59222c88cf6c34.speechText: You make the thing by which people are known. They knitted the blue bonnet out of waste wool until it was the badge of a whole country, then took in the dyers for one reason: a colour that fades is a small public lie. You would rather be true than fashionable. You would also rather change than die, and this craft has done exactly that twice.

531bcb3677cb77fd.displayText: You take what the world discards and make it worth keeping. Their founding charter has the two trades agreeing to unyte ourself in cherite togidder, and they hold the oldest charter of the fourteen while standing seventh in the line, and have never once made a fuss about it. You will outlast a good many people who talked more.
531bcb3677cb77fd.speechText: You take what the world discards and make it worth keeping. Their founding charter has the two trades agreeing to unyte ourself in cherite togidder, and they hold the oldest charter of the fourteen while standing seventh in the line, and have never once made a fuss about it. You will outlast a good many people who talked more.

0efb492fc0ad5b7a.displayText: A shoemaker’s son is a Prince born. That was theirs, and they meant it: they crowned their own King Crispin and paraded him through Glasgow while actual kings went about looking shabby. The same craft made six thousand pairs of shoes for an army that was not theirs, because feet are feet. Careful the crown does not become the point of it.
0efb492fc0ad5b7a.speechText: A shoemaker’s son is a Prince born. That was theirs, and they meant it: they crowned their own King Crispin and paraded him through Glasgow while actual kings went about looking shabby. The same craft made six thousand pairs of shoes for an army that was not theirs, because feet are feet. Careful the crown does not become the point of it.

8c4d6cadd786a6e5.displayText: The town must eat, today, at an honest weight. They went to prison rather than sign on the magistrates’ terms, and once fed an army the night before the battle that settled a kingdom. You feed people and you make no performance of it. Watch the shadow: the baker they punished was the one selling full loaves too cheaply.
8c4d6cadd786a6e5.speechText: The town must eat, today, at an honest weight. They went to prison rather than sign on the magistrates’ terms, and once fed an army the night before the battle that settled a kingdom. You feed people and you make no performance of it. Watch the shadow: the baker they punished was the one selling full loaves too cheaply.

96d51d9e4406d97b.displayText: You have the strong stomach that lets everybody else keep clean hands. Their signature fraud had a name of its own, the blawing of muttoun, and the man who could spot it was the same man who could have done it. They beat the magistrates in court in 1802 and never once rioted. Keep a calm sough. Just do not let steady harden into unmoved.
96d51d9e4406d97b.speechText: You have the strong stomach that lets everybody else keep clean hands. Their signature fraud had a name of its own, the blawing of muttoun, and the man who could spot it was the same man who could have done it. They beat the magistrates in court in 1802 and never once rioted. Keep a calm sough. Just do not let steady harden into unmoved.

7bdd0a06fc285c21.displayText: You are patient with what cannot be hurried. Twice Parliament declared them no craft at all; twice they quietly renamed their chief and bought their liberty back, and four and a half centuries on they are still led by a Visitor rather than a Deacon. There is a wall around your care, though, and it is worth asking now and then who is standing outside it.
7bdd0a06fc285c21.speechText: You are patient with what cannot be hurried. Twice Parliament declared them no craft at all; twice they quietly renamed their chief and bought their liberty back, and four and a half centuries on they are still led by a Visitor rather than a Deacon. There is a wall around your care, though, and it is worth asking now and then who is standing outside it.

24ecad62a4450f2e.displayText: Yours is the only craft whose arms show the moment everything went wrong, Adam and Eve and the serpent and the tree, and they read that not as a curse but as a claim: the one trade practised before the Fall. The moon on their shield is waxing. You plant for eyes that will not be yours. Not everything wants tending; some of it wants pruning.
24ecad62a4450f2e.speechText: Yours is the only craft whose arms show the moment everything went wrong, Adam and Eve and the serpent and the tree, and they read that not as a curse but as a claim: the one trade practised before the Fall. The moon on their shield is waxing. You plant for eyes that will not be yours. Not everything wants tending; some of it wants pruning.

f14d6e6083cad3d4.displayText: Every morning half a city bared its throat to a man holding a razor, and then talked. That is what you are for. Locked out of their own hall, they went to the kirk and took the minutes anyway and won by sheer patience; they booked Black journeymen in 1741, women in 1791, and petitioned against the slave trade in 1792. You are trusted with what people say when they relax, which is also the danger.
f14d6e6083cad3d4.speechText: Every morning half a city bared its throat to a man holding a razor, and then talked. That is what you are for. Locked out of their own hall, they went to the kirk and took the minutes anyway and won by sheer patience; they booked Black journeymen in 1741, women in 1791, and petitioned against the slave trade in 1792. You are trusted with what people say when they relax, which is also the danger.

d3cfec4c37242232.displayText: Living things, carried four hundred miles, and most of them still alive. That is a particular kind of attention.
d3cfec4c37242232.speechText: Living things, carried four hundred miles, and most of them still alive. That is a particular kind of attention.

2b674aadde1d8770.displayText: Paper instead of bread. Not one in ten would choose that, and you did not pause over it.
2b674aadde1d8770.speechText: Paper instead of bread. Not one in ten would choose that, and you did not pause over it.

9f9dc125ab00d8ed.displayText: You went in. I thought you might. Most do not, and that is not a judgment, it is a count.
9f9dc125ab00d8ed.speechText: You went in. I thought you might. Most do not, and that is not a judgment, it is a count.

2190e606c2b1285a.displayText: Three seconds for eight feet of ash. You will do that arithmetic again for the rest of your life.
2190e606c2b1285a.speechText: Three seconds for eight feet of ash. You will do that arithmetic again for the rest of your life.

632a4e47617b21a7.displayText: You made it everyone's. The three who did not move are moving now, and they will remember who made them.
632a4e47617b21a7.speechText: You made it everyone's. The three who did not move are moving now, and they will remember who made them.

0bbeb0fc222a5a24.displayText: You walked the gravel, and never once looked up at the people watching you take the long way.
0bbeb0fc222a5a24.speechText: You walked the gravel, and never once looked up at the people watching you take the long way.

bb123f4fd5a5dda1.displayText: A week on a thing you cannot explain, on the chance that somebody once could.
bb123f4fd5a5dda1.speechText: A week on a thing you cannot explain, on the chance that somebody once could.

21ce9ecb95e10e21.displayText: You went and asked. That makes you the stranger who questions things, and you knew it before you knew the answer.
21ce9ecb95e10e21.speechText: You went and asked. That makes you the stranger who questions things, and you knew it before you knew the answer.

2c8333707fde227d.displayText: Your joint, your soil, your sixty years. It is a better fence now, and it is not theirs.
2c8333707fde227d.speechText: Your joint, your soil, your sixty years. It is a better fence now, and it is not theirs.

4fbe7dd1944afaac.displayText: You changed the question. Sometimes that is wisdom and sometimes it is not listening, and from out here they look alike.
4fbe7dd1944afaac.speechText: You changed the question. Sometimes that is wisdom and sometimes it is not listening, and from out here they look alike.

2a922ad0e230d233.displayText: Your own. Nothing in it for them to take hold of, which means you will be filling it yourself, and slowly.
2a922ad0e230d233.speechText: Your own. Nothing in it for them to take hold of, which means you will be filling it yourself, and slowly.

57da975bdf111fa8.displayText: The work, then. Short and true, and it tells a stranger where to bring a broken thing.
57da975bdf111fa8.speechText: The work, then. Short and true, and it tells a stranger where to bring a broken thing.

0eb673359433d404.displayText: You let them choose. That is great trust or great tiredness, and I have known it be both at once.
0eb673359433d404.speechText: You let them choose. That is great trust or great tiredness, and I have known it be both at once.

b3b28b7083178e24.displayText: A name you have not earned yet. Forty years to catch it, and it will be watching you the whole way.
b3b28b7083178e24.speechText: A name you have not earned yet. Forty years to catch it, and it will be watching you the whole way.

12210fb9ff9e7c41.displayText: You will wait. Years, possibly, being right and poor, and the waiting will be the harder half of the work.
12210fb9ff9e7c41.speechText: You will wait. Years, possibly, being right and poor, and the waiting will be the harder half of the work.

a42b875c66cee816.displayText: You said it out loud. Somebody had to, and now you are the one who did.
a42b875c66cee816.speechText: You said it out loud. Somebody had to, and now you are the one who did.

88bb6120040c3528.displayText: You went to learn from them. That costs more pride than most people have to spend.
88bb6120040c3528.speechText: You went to learn from them. That costs more pride than most people have to spend.

fc3af22afe94ed35.displayText: You mend what they break and say nothing. A living built on their failures, which needs them to keep failing.
fc3af22afe94ed35.speechText: You mend what they break and say nothing. A living built on their failures, which needs them to keep failing.

64051f2b49624ed3.displayText: Every item, true, and nobody will ever know you did it. That is the whole of the thing.
64051f2b49624ed3.speechText: Every item, true, and nobody will ever know you did it. That is the whole of the thing.

92bfd09753296e95.displayText: You decided what you were owed with nobody else in the room. The room is the part that matters.
92bfd09753296e95.speechText: You decided what you were owed with nobody else in the room. The room is the part that matters.

d0a2e75983b1db32.displayText: You told him while he was still there to hear it. He may not have followed a word.
d0a2e75983b1db32.speechText: You told him while he was still there to hear it. He may not have followed a word.

fda4ff77207a268a.displayText: You spent it on being right about what it was for. You may well be right.
fda4ff77207a268a.speechText: You spent it on being right about what it was for. You may well be right.

173f96f7bf13dd0e.displayText: First into an empty pot. If nobody follows, you have given away your winter to prove a thing about your neighbours.
173f96f7bf13dd0e.speechText: First into an empty pot. If nobody follows, you have given away your winter to prove a thing about your neighbours.

fd0b8ed1d34b96b7.displayText: Arithmetic before feeling. You will learn exactly who lied about their cellar, and greet them all spring.
fd0b8ed1d34b96b7.speechText: Arithmetic before feeling. You will learn exactly who lied about their cellar, and greet them all spring.

40c05f6050b0b8e3.displayText: You made it go further. Nobody thanks the one who makes thin things bearable. I noticed.
40c05f6050b0b8e3.speechText: You made it go further. Nobody thanks the one who makes thin things bearable. I noticed.

63f9b7e55c31ee70.displayText: You decided, alone, that you understood her better than her own instruction did.
63f9b7e55c31ee70.speechText: You decided, alone, that you understood her better than her own instruction did.

aa31ab564c02d97c.displayText: Shut. Whatever is behind it may be past saving, and a trust that holds only while it is easy was never one.
aa31ab564c02d97c.speechText: Shut. Whatever is behind it may be past saving, and a trust that holds only while it is easy was never one.

e680333f6e2ddef5.displayText: You called her home. You will both know you could not settle it yourself, and that is not nothing.
e680333f6e2ddef5.speechText: You called her home. You will both know you could not settle it yourself, and that is not nothing.

d1fa2fbc8c8e1f13.displayText: You went around it. Clever, and slow, and the roof does not care which.
d1fa2fbc8c8e1f13.speechText: You went around it. Clever, and slow, and the roof does not care which.

c8b6c5d903b9163f.displayText: A season of digging and a bad year for everyone. Some of those households are the ones in the low cottages.
c8b6c5d903b9163f.speechText: A season of digging and a bad year for everyone. Some of those households are the ones in the low cottages.

a2241421644caf60.displayText: You made them look at one another. Towns do not forgive the one who held the mirror up.
a2241421644caf60.speechText: You made them look at one another. Towns do not forgive the one who held the mirror up.

598b71c9e2a868a0.displayText: You walked out. The water runs on without you, and you knew that before you took the first step.
598b71c9e2a868a0.speechText: You walked out. The water runs on without you, and you knew that before you took the first step.

a51759a9d75c53a2.displayText: Seven years, the whole of it. You will be making the person who takes your custom, and you know it.
a51759a9d75c53a2.speechText: Seven years, the whole of it. You will be making the person who takes your custom, and you know it.

aa0b91c8220a2b96.displayText: All of it but the one turn. They will feel that door long before they can name it.
aa0b91c8220a2b96.speechText: All of it but the one turn. They will feel that door long before they can name it.

f6a6e3154811093e.displayText: Hands first. They will have your habits before your reasons, including the ones you would not have chosen to pass on.
f6a6e3154811093e.speechText: Hands first. They will have your habits before your reasons, including the ones you would not have chosen to pass on.

9d42a4f67a6cb3cf.displayText: You sent them away to find out. They may not come back, and you sent them anyway.
9d42a4f67a6cb3cf.speechText: You sent them away to find out. They may not come back, and you sent them anyway.

775d8457de990464.displayText: Thirty years of edges ground to your hand, and only your hand.
775d8457de990464.speechText: Thirty years of edges ground to your hand, and only your hand.

644ea58eb56da728.displayText: Sixty years of a trade, most of it not yours, carried out through the smoke.
644ea58eb56da728.speechText: Sixty years of a trade, most of it not yours, carried out through the smoke.

9b4b49b0dbf6b8bb.displayText: Four sacks of next year. Heavy, and slow, and you were still in the room.
9b4b49b0dbf6b8bb.speechText: Four sacks of next year. Heavy, and slow, and you were still in the room.

a561bd8602ca64c4.displayText: Through the wall. You will own nothing by morning, and you did not stop to work that out first.
a561bd8602ca64c4.speechText: Through the wall. You will own nothing by morning, and you did not stop to work that out first.

d31ae7fab1529fbf.displayText: The mark, tested, the same for everyone. Some who would have been good in five years will be good somewhere else.
d31ae7fab1529fbf.speechText: The mark, tested, the same for everyone. Some who would have been good in five years will be good somewhere else.

efd9930a4256f228.displayText: You opened it to whoever needs it. The name is the only thing this town has, and you have put it in other hands.
efd9930a4256f228.speechText: You opened it to whoever needs it. The name is the only thing this town has, and you have put it in other hands.

2a4c3529bc741dcf.displayText: A hundred winters came through on that gate, and you have unmade it in a season.
2a4c3529bc741dcf.speechText: A hundred winters came through on that gate, and you have unmade it in a season.

1c06d9888a7ea027.displayText: Not who — how. Someone will be kept out one day by a sentence you wrote tonight, and you wrote it anyway.
1c06d9888a7ea027.speechText: Not who — how. Someone will be kept out one day by a sentence you wrote tonight, and you wrote it anyway.

20375c24e7e61953.displayText: Stand still a moment. Let me look at you properly.
20375c24e7e61953.speechText: Stand still a moment. Let me look at you properly.

d9f8dbf54822c64c.displayText: More than one of them has a claim on you. I can feel the pull of it.
d9f8dbf54822c64c.speechText: More than one of them has a claim on you. I can feel the pull of it.

45a632b2cd7f4bee.displayText: That one took you a moment.
45a632b2cd7f4bee.speechText: That one took you a moment.

21ed32970b9c51c0.displayText: That is a wall. I am on it.
21ed32970b9c51c0.speechText: That is a wall. I am on it.

c1a445fda4a24502.displayText: You have found the one thing in this room that cannot feel anything.
c1a445fda4a24502.speechText: You have found the one thing in this room that cannot feel anything.

d679067bf0b9b41c.displayText: There is a river out there and a year ahead of you, and you are doing this.
d679067bf0b9b41c.speechText: There is a river out there and a year ahead of you, and you are doing this.

7686a475ec0f4472.displayText: I have been looked at by better and prodded by worse.
7686a475ec0f4472.speechText: I have been looked at by better and prodded by worse.

1dded5cc24d0802d.displayText: The paint is older than your country. Be careful with it, or do not. It is all one to the paint.
1dded5cc24d0802d.speechText: The paint is older than your country. Be careful with it, or do not. It is all one to the paint.

7b37f0884aeb6bfc.displayText: I can wait longer than you can. It is the single thing I am good at.
7b37f0884aeb6bfc.speechText: I can wait longer than you can. It is the single thing I am good at.

b7bfc472e7f39f8d.displayText: Enough, now. There is a child in a river and you are poking a picture.
b7bfc472e7f39f8d.speechText: Enough, now. There is a child in a river and you are poking a picture.

c2f07ab3ac863808.displayText: The light crosses this floor the same way every day. I have had time to check.
c2f07ab3ac863808.speechText: The light crosses this floor the same way every day. I have had time to check.

17e89d2ddd97977a.displayText: There were others on this wall once. Moved, or painted over, or simply stopped being looked at.
17e89d2ddd97977a.speechText: There were others on this wall once. Moved, or painted over, or simply stopped being looked at.

10cb5323db32f868.displayText: Take the time. Nobody here is going anywhere, and I am the least likely of us.
10cb5323db32f868.speechText: Take the time. Nobody here is going anywhere, and I am the least likely of us.

3169891df726dd10.displayText: You have stood here before. I remember the shape of you. Let us see whether you have changed your mind or only your mood.
3169891df726dd10.speechText: You have stood here before. I remember the shape of you. Let us see whether you have changed your mind or only your mood.

2a36bb8f85e8212f.displayText: You answer fast. That is no fault; some people know themselves early. Only do not mistake speed for certainty.
2a36bb8f85e8212f.speechText: You answer fast. That is no fault; some people know themselves early. Only do not mistake speed for certainty.

c8bc50a0c8dc3f89.displayText: You sat a long while with that one. The quick answer is usually somebody else's answer, borrowed.
c8bc50a0c8dc3f89.speechText: You sat a long while with that one. The quick answer is usually somebody else's answer, borrowed.

222d6908927666f8.displayText: You keep reaching for the same place on the table. I am not judging you. I am saying I noticed.
222d6908927666f8.speechText: You keep reaching for the same place on the table. I am not judging you. I am saying I noticed.

e18eb5dcd31cd362.displayText: You keep cutting me off. That is all right. I have had four hundred years of practice at being interrupted.
e18eb5dcd31cd362.speechText: You keep cutting me off. That is all right. I have had four hundred years of practice at being interrupted.

f759d8f89053d731.displayText: I was not asleep. I was looking at something you cannot see from where you stand.
f759d8f89053d731.speechText: I was not asleep. I was looking at something you cannot see from where you stand.

44054bab54c25175.displayText: I will tell you about a year. You came here with nothing, and twelve times the choosing cost you something.
44054bab54c25175.speechText: I will tell you about a year. You came here with nothing, and twelve times the choosing cost you something.

6628d1a48a05bf7b.displayText: There are no right answers. In four hundred years I have never seen a wrong one — only people leaning different ways under weight.
6628d1a48a05bf7b.speechText: There are no right answers. In four hundred years I have never seen a wrong one — only people leaning different ways under weight.

82abf81c22f1c4ad.displayText: Which way you lean is what I am watching. At the end I will name where you belong. Do not try to steer it — you cannot.
82abf81c22f1c4ad.speechText: Which way you lean is what I am watching. At the end I will name where you belong. Do not try to steer it — you cannot.

2fe710dd65b30170.displayText: They set you to mend a fence that starts in the middle of good pasture and stops in the middle of it. It keeps no beast in and no weather out. When you ask what it is for, the woman who set you the work says it has always been there, and goes back inside.
2fe710dd65b30170.speechText: They set you to mend a fence that starts in the middle of good pasture and stops in the middle of it. It keeps no beast in and no weather out. When you ask what it is for, the woman who set you the work says it has always been there, and goes back inside.

c5925d8c04d49570.displayText: You find out the way everyone finds out: someone tells you over work, plainly, as though it were weather. The mill leat runs through the low cottages, and every third year it floods them. The town has known for sixty years how to move it, and has not, because moving it takes the water off the mill. Everything here is built on that. Your bench included.
c5925d8c04d49570.speechText: You find out the way everyone finds out: someone tells you over work, plainly, as though it were weather. The mill leat runs through the low cottages, and every third year it floods them. The town has known for sixty years how to move it, and has not, because moving it takes the water off the mill. Everything here is built on that. Your bench included.

89e638a54c987145.displayText: Iron. You said it before you had quite decided to, which is how I knew it was true.
89e638a54c987145.speechText: Iron. You said it before you had quite decided to, which is how I knew it was true.

25d492c7648d05c8.displayText: Nothing in the bag, and four hundred miles on your feet. You will be believed on how you walked in, or you will not, and you have decided to find out which.
25d492c7648d05c8.speechText: Nothing in the bag, and four hundred miles on your feet. You will be believed on how you walked in, or you will not, and you have decided to find out which.

bf4dda0c21acbe1f.displayText: Three mouths, four hard months, and the seed kept back. The town will remember this longer than the winter lasts.
bf4dda0c21acbe1f.speechText: Three mouths, four hard months, and the seed kept back. The town will remember this longer than the winter lasts.

7fc0fa679ad6105a.displayText: Stone under eleven floors, starting Monday, and the leat stays. You made the wrong thing bearable, which is how it lasted sixty years.
7fc0fa679ad6105a.speechText: Stone under eleven floors, starting Monday, and the leat stays. You made the wrong thing bearable, which is how it lasted sixty years.
